Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix: Prevent regex corruption of JSX during TypeScript stripping

The _convert_to_browser_react\(\) function was using dangerous regex patterns that corrupted valid JSX code:

1. Line 351: re.DOTALL with [^}]* matched across component boundaries, removing closing };
2. Line 401: Applied type-stripping regex to ALL parentheses, including JSX expressions
3. Line 405: Overly broad character class matched and removed className={...} attributes

Changes:
- Remove re.DOTALL flag from interface removal - match single lines only
- Simplify type annotation removal to only match simple types in obvious contexts
- Restrict return type stripping to known type names only

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix: Add is_approved and type/variant to regenerate_library

The library search filters for is_approved=True but regenerate_library
wasn''t setting this field. This caused the library search to fail,
falling back to AI generation which produces truncated/broken code.

Changes:
- Add is_approved=True to make components findable
- Add component_type and variant fields for better matching

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Phase 1: Zero-Transform Architecture for library components

- Skip regex transformation for library-composed code in vercel_deployer.py
- Add JSX validation before saving components to library
- Change library component language from ''tsx'' to ''jsx'' \(browser-ready\)

This prevents regex corruption of valid JSX by detecting library-composed
code and skipping the TypeScript transformation entirely.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix: Replace template literals with string concatenation in library components

Template literals in className \(className={`...$...`}\) were being
corrupted during deployment. Replaced with string concatenation
\(className={"..." + \(condition ? "..." : "..."\)}\) which is more
robust for browser Babel transformation.

Components fixed:
- NavigationHeader
- SettingsView  
- DashboardStats
- PricingTable
- TestimonialsCarousel

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
